name: Percy Jackson
excerpt: Percy Jackson is a twelve-year-old half-blood who accidentally vaporizes his pre-algebra teacher.
notes: Percy Jackson is a twelve-year-old boy who attends Yancy Academy, a private school for troubled kids in upstate New York. He has dyslexia and attention deficit disorder and has been expelled from multiple schools. Percy is a half-blood, which he describes as dangerous and life-threatening. He has a chaotic life and experiences strange events, such as accidentally vaporizing his pre-algebra teacher, Mrs. Dodds, who turns out to be a supernatural creature.
